subject: Weekend hiccup
text:
The train strike is making Saturday tricky, but I still want to see you. If my late train clears, I'll head straight to the market and grab us some pastries before we meet. If not, I'll call as soon as the app gives a clue. Worst case, we move it to the cafe by your place at five. I'll figure it out. Sorry for the change again.
Talk soon
